title: VoxelCore weather preset
description: Weather preset (<pack>/presets/weather/<name>.json), read by WeatherPreset::deserialize; the same table is passed to gfx.weather.change.
markdownDescription: Weather preset (`<pack>/presets/weather/<name>.json`), read by `WeatherPreset::deserialize`; the same table is passed to `gfx.weather.change`.

hspeed.markdownDescription:
Maximum horizontal speed of precipitation

Default: `0.1`.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/scripting/builtins/libgfx-weather.md#gfxweather-library)
hspeed.description:

min_opacity.description:
Minimum alpha multiplier for precipitation

Default: 0.

max_opacity.markdownDescription:

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/scripting/builtins/libgfx-weather.md#gfxweather-library)
max_opacity.description:

particles.title: VoxelCore particles preset
particles.description: Particle emitter settings (a block's particles object, a weather fall.splash, or the preset table of gfx.particles.emit). All fields are optional.
particles.markdownDescription: Particle emitter settings (a block's `particles` object, a weather `fall.splash`, or the `preset` table of `gfx.particles.emit`). All fields are optional.

frames.markdownDescription:
Animation frames (array of texture names). Must be in a single atlas.

When set, the first frame replaces `texture` and `random_sub_uv` is forced to 1.

Default: `[]`.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/particles.md#particles)
frames.description:
Animation frames (array of texture names). Must be in a single atlas.

When set, the first frame replaces texture and random_sub_uv is forced to 1.

Default: [].

global_up_vector.markdownDescription:
Use the global up vector instead of the camera-dependent one when orienting particles.

Default: `false`.
global_up_vector.description:
Use the global up vector instead of the camera-dependent one when orienting particles.

Default: false.

max_distance.markdownDescription:
Maximum distance from the camera at which particles may spawn.

Default: `32`.

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/particles.md#particles)
max_distance.description:
Maximum distance from the camera at which particles may spawn.

Default: 32.

spawn_interval.markdownDescription:
Particle spawn interval in seconds. Also initial spawn delay

spawn_interval.description:
